def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    ideal_ratio = 0.7
    ideal_occupancy = ideal_ratio * bins
    current_occupancy = bins - (bins - item)  # This is just the current bin content before adding item
    # But since we don't track current content, we use the idea that adding item will bring us closer to ideal
    projected_occupancy = bins - item + item  # This is just bins, so we need better logic

    # Instead, we approximate: assume each bin has current load = bins - remaining_capacity
    # But since we don’t have load info, we model "ideal" as being at 70% of capacity after adding item
    projected_after = bins - item + item  # Again not useful

    # Correct approach: We don't know current load, so instead, we assume all bins start empty
    # Then the best fit is when after adding, they are near 70% of capacity
    # So target residual = 30% of capacity
    target_residual = 0.3 * bins
    actual_residual = bins - item
    deviation = np.abs(actual_residual - target_residual)
    # Lower deviation means better fit, so higher priority
    priority_scores = 1 / (1 + deviation + 1e-8)  # Avoid division by zero
    # Penalize overfilled bins heavily
    overfilled = actual_residual < 0
    priority_scores[overfilled] = 0
    return priority_scores

    return np.where(bins >= item, priorities, 0)

    # Compute entropy of remaining capacities for valid bins
    # Higher entropy indicates more uniform spread of remaining space
    # Use log(1 + remaining) to avoid log(0)
    log_remaining = np.log1p(remaining)
    # Normalize log_remaining to [0, 1] range for entropy calculation
    min_log, max_log = np.min(log_remaining[valid_bins]), np.max(log_remaining[valid_bins])
    if max_log == min_log:
        normalized = np.zeros_like(log_remaining)
    else:
        normalized = (log_remaining - min_log) / (max_log - min_log)
    
    # Compute entropy-like score: higher entropy means higher priority
    # Entropy formula: -sum(p_i * log(p_i)), but we use deviation from uniformity
    n_valid = np.sum(valid_bins)
    if n_valid == 0:
        return np.zeros_like(bins)
    p = normalized[valid_bins] / np.sum(normalized[valid_bins])
    entropy_score = -np.sum(p * np.log(p + 1e-12))  # Add small value to avoid log(0)
    
    # Prioritize bins with higher entropy contribution
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    priorities[valid_bins] = entropy_score * (1 + normalized[valid_bins])
    
    return priorities

    # Avoid negative or zero values for log
    safe_remaining = np.where(remaining_after > 0, remaining_after, 1e-8)

    # Use log to compress large deviations and emphasize moderate ones
    log_deviation = np.log1p(deviation_from_ideal)
    # Geometric mean of normalized remaining capacity and inverse of log-deviation
    normalized_remaining = safe_remaining / bins
    priority_scores = np.sqrt(normalized_remaining * (1 / (1 + log_deviation)))
    # Penalize overfilled bins
    return np.where(remaining_after >= 0, priority_scores, 0)
